title: FlakeXplain v0.8 replication package: MDFlaker on fresh GitHub Actions test failures
description:
Replication package for the FlakeXplain v0.8 study. It contains 1,659 failed pytest executions from recent GitHub Actions runs of 8 Python projects, each re-run 30 times in a matching environment. That produced 1,292 labelled failures: 409 flaky and 883 not flaky. The package compares MDFlaker's reimplemented classifier with an ExtraTrees model on failure-evidence features.

Contents: collection, rerun, labelling, feature and analysis scripts; the GitHub Actions rerun workflow; derived data (candidates, label-blind features, labels, per-candidate rerun outcome summaries and the parsed CI failure history) with SHA-256 manifest. Raw CI logs are not included.
